Lime Chiffon is one of Strawberry Shortcake's friends, and is a graceful girl. She is either a ballerina with a love of dance or a fashionista with a love of books.


General Information
1980s
The character made her debut during the third special, Strawberry Shortcake: Pets on Parade. Lime is the bubbly, airy ballerina whose every movement is filled with elegance and smoothness, even if she gets in the way for some reason. With high energy and a light mood, Lime can often be found with her pet, Parfait Parrot.

Berry in the Big City
After a nearly 40 year-long absence from the franchise, Lime Chiffon returns as a part of the main cast in the 2021 series. She is now an intelligent Afro-Latina girl with a love of fashion and books. Lime Chiffon co-owns and runs the LemonLime Time juice cart alongside her best friend and business partner, Lemon Meringue, at the Berryworks in Big Apple City. Her second best friend is Bread Pudding, who is just as much a fashionista as she is. Her dads are the historian Dr. Lime Pops and famous fashion designer Fluffy Chiffon, both of whom were a big influence on her current interests in fashion and learning.

Personality
1980's
A girl with a "flighty" personality, it can be pretty hard to hold onto Lime's attention for long. She doesn't seem to pay attention too much, so often has to be called to or pulled out of the way. But then she'll simply dance away without a care. It has been implied that Parfait may actually be smarter than her.

2021
"Lime Chiffon is the most stylish and booksmart friend around! Together with pet friend, Parfait the parrot they know a lot about a lot, sharing a love for fashion and books." - From the Berry in the Big City website

Lime is a sweet and friendly girl. She is the brainy, intelligent, and bookish one of the group. Just like Blueberry she loves mysteries and is eager to solve any. She randomly owns Sherlock Holmes-style hats and claims she knows everything about solving a mystery because she reads a lot of Apricot Christie books. (Apricot Christie is a pun on one of the most well-known mystery authors in the world, Agatha Christie.) She is often a know-it-all but means well. She also gets annoyed or tired easily and she's usually no-nonsense. She's close to Lemon Meringue.

Lime is not just a bookworm, she's also very into fashion. She likes exciting and extravagant new styles, as well as fancy but classic and simple styles. She strongly believes that you cannot go out to a nice restaurant without being dressed in the proper dress code. This influence is probably from her dads.

Lime also tends to be loud and gets manic in small bursts when she is excited about something. Other times she is usually more serious and composed. Lime also has a tendency to panic when placed in a stressful situation to the point of being unable to function. Lime is now a chubby Afro-Latina girl with tannish-brown skin, green eyes, baby-fat cheeks, square glasses, and emerald earrings. She has brown and lime green-streaked hair in pigtails and lime-shaped hair-ties. Lime wears a lime green overall skirt with a lime emblem on it over a sky blue T-shirt and pastel blue leggings, and lime green riding boots. Her skirt is stylized to look like a lime wedge.

In summer episodes, Lime wears a sleeveless jumpsuit with a lime green and pastel green vertical stripe pattern all across, a sky-blue sash belt tied in a bow, and close-toed sandals.

In winter episodes, Lime wears her normal clothes, with a large green winter coat that covers her body down to her knees, sky-blue mittens, and a pastel green scarf with a lime wedge pattern.
